description: Read an overview of the whole pinned registry in one reply: every active object (domain, description, tags, the traits it uses and its field names) and every trait (category, description, tags, contexts and the objects that use it), keyed by name, with the registry’s loaded names, any loader issues, a canonical etag and generatedAt. The full snapshot, with every semantic, token, parameter and view extension, is larger than this endpoint’s 100,000-character reply bound; overview names what this reply leaves out and the full snapshot’s size. includeInternal adds OODS Foundry’s internal objects, which registry.hiddenInternal counts otherwise. Use object_registry show instead for one object’s composed definition, and catalog_list for components. Read-only, with no side effects: it writes nothing and changes no state.

inputSchema.description: Bulk-read recorded mappings plus live shipped and registered team traits and objects. Reports definition loader issues, including shadowed names. Draft preferred_terms, disambiguation_decisions and capabilities are not snapshot outputs.

includeInternal.description: Also list OODS Foundry's internal (non-business) objects, after the business objects. Without it they are left out and registry.hiddenInternal counts them.

inputSchema.title: registry.snapshot input
